GRAM-US PAPER 2: SCREENING FOR COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT

l.inputs1 <- l.inputs
l.inputs1[["n.cycle"]] <- 51
l.inputs1[["n.ind"]] <- 1000
l.inputs1[["p.HCARE_start"]] <- c(0.25,0.75)
l.inputs1[["hr.mort_mci_age"]] <- c(1, 1, 1)
l.inputs1[["hr.mort_mod_age"]] <- l.inputs1[["hr.mort_sev_age"]] <- c(1, 1, 1)
l.inputs1[["seed_stochastic"]] <- 20250624

l.inputs1[["r.CDRslow_mean"]] <-  
  (seq(0, 1, length.out = 51)^1.5) * (1.5 * l.inputs[["r.CDRslow_mean"]])
l.inputs1[["m.hr_mci"]] <- l.inputs[["m.hr_mci"]] * 2.2 /4

Scenarios

Scenario 1: Universal Testing

l.inputs1a <- l.inputs1
l.inputs1a[["scenario"]][["scenario"]] <- "Scenario 1a: Universal BHA, annual testing until first BHA+" 

universal1 <- f.wrap_run(l.inputs1a, microdata = sample1)

l.inputs1b <- l.inputs1
l.inputs1b[["scenario"]][["scenario"]] <- "Scenario 1b: Universal BHA, testing every other years until first BHA+"
l.inputs1b[["scenario"]][["repeat_interval"]] <- 2

universal2 <- f.wrap_run(l.inputs1b, microdata = sample1)



inputs_list <- list(l.inputs1a, l.inputs1b)
scenario_list <- list(universal1, universal2)

all_results <- map2_dfr(inputs_list, scenario_list, compute_results)
# flextable(all_results)

 sim <- all_results %>%
   filter(Age == 70)

 
 pv_results <- all_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PPV, NPV), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  select(Scenario, Age, Metric, Value) 

fig_results <- ggplot(data = pv_results, aes(x = Age, y = Value, color = Scenario)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = Scenario)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkgray","orange","darkred")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dotted", "dashed", "solid")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical")

fig_results

Scenario 2: Prompted Testing

l.inputs2 <- l.inputs1
l.inputs2[["scenario"]][["scenario"]] <- "Scenario 2: Prompted BHA"
l.inputs2[["m.cogcon"]] <- l.inputs1[["m.cogcon"]]
l.inputs2[["m.cogcon"]][ ,"h"] <- 0.07
l.inputs2[["m.cogcon"]][ ,"mci"] <- 0.70
l.inputs2[["m.cogcon"]][ ,"dem"] <- 0.95
l.inputs2[["scenario"]][["probs_cogcon"]] <- l.inputs2[["m.cogcon"]]

prompted <- f.wrap_run(l.inputs2, microdata = sample1)
[1] "hello"
[1] "hello"

Scenario 3: Reactive Testing

l.inputs3 <- l.inputs1
l.inputs3[["scenario"]][["scenario"]] <- "Scenario 3: Reactive Testing"
l.inputs3[["m.cogcon"]] <- l.inputs1[["m.cogcon"]]
l.inputs3[["m.cogcon"]][ ,"h"] <- 0.005
l.inputs3[["m.cogcon"]][ ,"mci"] <- 0.20
l.inputs3[["m.cogcon"]][ ,"dem"] <- 0.90
l.inputs3[["scenario"]][["probs_cogcon"]] <- l.inputs3[["m.cogcon"]]

reactive <- f.wrap_run(l.inputs3, microdata = sample1)
[1] "hello"
[1] "hello"

Compute Results

compute_results <- function(inputs, scenario) {
  map_dfr(50:100, function(age) {
    testperf <- f.analyze_test_performance(scenario, age - 50 + 1)
    tibble(
      Scenario = inputs[["scenario"]][["scenario"]],
      Age = age,
      N_Tests = testperf$total_tests,
      TP = sum(testperf$concordance_table[c("mci","dem"), "BHApos"]),
      FN = sum(testperf$concordance_table[c("mci","dem"), "BHAneg"]),
      TN = sum(testperf$concordance_table[c("h","tci"), "BHAneg"]),
      FP = sum(testperf$concordance_table[c("h","tci"), "BHApos"]),
      PPV = round(testperf$ppv, 3),
      NPV = round(testperf$npv, 3)
    )
  })
}

inputs_list <- list(l.inputs1a, l.inputs2, l.inputs3)
scenario_list <- list(universal1, prompted, reactive)

all_results <- map2_dfr(inputs_list, scenario_list, compute_results)
# flextable(all_results)

 sim <- all_results %>%
   filter(Age == 70)

 
 pv_results <- all_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PPV, NPV), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  select(Scenario, Age, Metric, Value) 

fig_results <- ggplot(data = pv_results, aes(x = Age, y = Value, color = Scenario)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = Scenario)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkgray","orange","darkred")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dotted", "dashed", "solid")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical")
